answer: In the dawn of autonomous agent economies, a practical Sybil-resistance mechanism can be implemented using a vault system where agents stake a sable amount of tokens. Each epoch, agents must verify their identity through cryptographic proofs, incurring a cost proportional to the stake. This ensures that attackers face a significantly higher cost to create multiple identities, as they must continually invest in the sable tokens, making large-scale Sybil attacks economically unfeasible.
